text: ∀x (TsunamiTrigger(x) ↔ (UnderwaterEarthquakes(x) ∨ VolcanicEruptions(x) ∨ Landslides(x))) ∧ ∀y (MassiveWaves(y) ∧ CausedBy(y, x) → DevastateCoastalAreas(y)) ::: A tsunami can be triggered by underwater earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or landslides, causing a series of massive waves that devastate coastal areas.
